title: .net/C#
excerpt: This course is designed for students who want to learn Programming with Microsoft .Net C#, and is also ideal for beginners who have never coded before. Starting with an introduction to the .Net C# language, you will learn how to create variables and use loops and functions. You will learn advanced concepts, such as Generics, MVC, LINQ, Windows Forms, ASP.Net Basics, Web Services, Introduction to .Net Core. At the end a single individual will be able to make industry level projects.

title: UI/UX & Graphic Designing
excerpt: In this course, you will gain comprehensive knowledge of graphic designing and UI/UX design. The course will guide you through the entire process, starting from the basics of opening the design program to completing a finished design. You will become proficient in using all the necessary tools and learn when and how to apply them effectively. Additionally, the course will focus on teaching you the principles of graphics and UI/UX design, enabling you to create purposeful and well-designed projects.

title: Basic Web Development
excerpt: A basic web development course provides foundational knowledge and skills in designing and building websites. This course covers fundamental concepts such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, which are the building blocks of the web. Participants will learn how to structure web pages, style them using CSS, and add interactivity using JavaScript. Additionally, the course may touch upon topics like responsive design, website optimization, and basic web security practices. By the end of the course, students will have a solid understanding of web development principles and be able to create simple,functional website from scratch.
details:
ABOUT THIS COURSE

A basic web development course provides foundational knowledge and skills in designing and building websites. This course covers fundamental concepts such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, which are the building blocks of the web. Participants will learn how to structure web pages, style them using CSS, and add interactivity using JavaScript. Additionally, the course may touch upon topics like responsive design, website optimization, and basic web security practices. By the end of the course, students will have a solid understanding of web development principles and be able to create simple,functional website from scratch.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
  • HTML Basics: You will learn how to create the structure and content of web pages using HTML tags and elements.
  • CSS Styling: You will discover how to enhance the appearance of web pages with CSS by adding colors, fonts, and layouts.
  • JavaScript Interactivity: You will acquire skills in using JavaScript to create interactive elements and add functionality to web pages.
  • Responsive Design: You will understand how to create websites that adapt and display properly on different devices and screen sizes.
  • Web Development Tools: You will be introduce to essential web development tools and techniques that aid in coding, debugging, and optimizing web pages.

title: Advertising with Meta
excerpt: This course will establish you as an expert in Meta Ads Manager. Learn how to structure campaigns in Ads Manager by selecting ad objectives, target audience, budget, and placement that fit your unique goals.Learn to create and manage ads across Facebook and Instagram and evaluate and optimize the results of your Ads Manager campaigns. You will end the course by creating an actual ad campaign in Ads Manager to expand not only your knowledge, but your social media marketing portfolio. Learners don't need marketing experience, but they have basic internet navigation skills and are eager to participate and connect in social media.
